Subject: Prompt-set regression guard & canary/rollback plan — handoff to Implementation

Hi Ava / NimbleDocs integrations team,

As discussed in our kickoff call yesterday, this thread is the formal handoff for Quality Monitoring (QMon) setup for your document-summarization feature. Attached are the initial prompt set (nimble_promptset_v1.csv) and our draft canary playbook (qmon-canary-playbook.pdf). Key asks for your team before Implementation kickoff next week: 

- Confirm the 12 canonical prompt variants in nimble_promptset_v1.csv (we included the original prompt + 11 edge-case prompts).
- Provide a safe sample of production traffic (anonymized) for eval harness onboarding — 500 requests recommended.
- Confirm which team will host the webhook endpoint for regression alerts (we can send to integrations@nimbledocs.com or to a PagerDuty integration).

Implementation scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- Integrate your prompt set into our eval harness and run baseline metrics (accuracy, hallucination rate, fluency)
- Wire real-time regression alerts: threshold-based on delta from baseline (default: >6% increase in hallucination score or >10% degradation in ROUGE-L over a rolling 24h window triggers warning; sustained for 1 hour triggers critical)
- Canary rollout config: 5% traffic for 2 hours -> 20% for 6 hours -> full ramp, with automatic rollback if critical triggers fire at any stage

Operational notes:
- We will seed the eval harness with labeled golden responses you provided (column "golden_response" in the CSV).
- For the first month we recommend alerting to both the integrations inbox and the NimbleDocs on-call PD; after that, move to summary-only for ops.

Action items (please reply inline):
1) Confirm prompt set finalization by EOD Monday 5/14.
2) Provide sample traffic S3 link or allow Redwood to pull from the sandbox by 5/15.
3) Confirm alert recipient (email or PD) and escalation contacts.

Thanks — aiming to kick off the eval-harness integration by 5/16.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

- We pulled nimble_promptset_v1.csv and found 12 prompt variants as expected. Two edge cases Ava promised (abbreviations + footnotes) added to a draft supplemental file; awaiting final CSV.
- Reranker: NimbleDocs sent a private Docker image link; security ran a quick scan (no high-severity findings). We'll run the reranker in the eval sandbox and persist predictions to the harness only.

Next steps for NimbleDocs: share the final CSV and confirm PD integration key. For Redwood: we'll schedule the baseline run Thursday 5/17 and send the first baseline report by EOD 5/18.
